title: Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlighting the power of winning hearts through vision, thoughts, words, and actions
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam today, highlighting the power of winning hearts through vision, thoughts, words, and actions.
The Prime Minister wrote on X;
"हमारे युवा साथी देश का भविष्य ही नहीं, वर्तमान की सबसे बड़ी शक्ति भी हैं। उन्होंने अपनी संवेदनशीलता, सेवाभाव और सामर्थ्य से दुनियाभर में अलग पहचान बनाई है।
चक्षुषा मनसा वाचा कर्मणा च चतुर्विधम्।
प्रसादयति यो लोकं तं लोकोऽनुप्रसीदति।।"
A person who wins people's hearts through his vision, thoughts, words and actions earns, in return, their trust, respect and goodwill.
हमारे युवा साथी देश का भविष्य ही नहीं, वर्तमान की सबसे बड़ी शक्ति भी हैं। उन्होंने अपनी संवेदनशीलता, सेवाभाव और सामर्थ्य से दुनियाभर में अलग पहचान बनाई है। चक्षुषा मनसा वाचा कर्मणा च चतुर्विधम्। प्रसादयति यो लोकं तं लोकोऽनुप्रसीदति।। pic.twitter.com/KdortN0NpC — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 12, 2026

enrichment.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam (aphorism) on X, emphasizing that a person who wins people's hearts through vision, thoughts, words, and actions earns trust, respect, and goodwill in return. He linked this message to praising India's youth, calling them not just the country's future but its greatest present strength, citing their sensitivity, service orientation, and capability that has given them a distinct global identity.
enrichment.context: This release is a routine social media post by the Prime Minister sharing a piece of Sanskrit wisdom literature, a practice he frequently follows to convey moral or motivational messages, often tied to occasions like International Youth Day (12 August). Such posts typically aim to inspire citizens, especially youth, and reflect the government's broader emphasis on promoting Indian classical knowledge traditions and youth empowerment narratives. This falls under the category of ceremonial/inspirational communication rather than a policy announcement, scheme, or governance decision.
